name: Stagonosuchus
isnote: Possibly a loricatan synonymous with Prestosuchus, or a poposauroid (English Wikipedia).
sum: Stagonosuchus is a paracrocodylomorph from the Middle Triassic Manda Beds of Tanzania, possibly synonymous with Prestosuchus.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Manda Beds (4 PBDB occurrences).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Huene 1938
